notes: New: Z.ai tasks keep running with the screen off. A dataSync foreground service holds the engine open during generation: persistent notification with the live phase/tool step/elapsed and a working Stop button, plus result notifications (answered / needs attention / ended). Android's 6-hour dataSync limit is handled gracefully with a checkpoint + notify before it hits. The chat-engine task queue is now persisted: tasks killed mid-run are reported on the next start, and a task queued within 10 minutes is re-sent automatically once you are signed in again. CLI agents unchanged. Same key, one-tap update.
